5234.title: Latest-state lookup is already linear on main
5234.rootCauseOneLine: The former event-correlated MAX lookup repeated unrelated history scans; main already selects one latest matching row per requested thread.
5234.proposedFix: No new patch: main includes merged repair #4931 since October 5, 2026.
5234.caveats: Installed desktop artifacts and production stalls were not tested; two source-main reproductions show linear JSON inspection and no goal rows.
